footnote_text: On November 2, 2026, Kimberly-Clark Corporation, a Delaware corporation ("K-C"), acquired the Company pursuant to that certain Agreement and Plan of Merger dated November 2, 2025, by and among the Company, K-C, Vesta Sub I, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of K-C, and Vesta Sub II, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of K-C (the "Merger Agreement"). In accordance with the terms of the Merger Agreement, each share of the Company's common stock ("Company Common Stock") was exchanged for 0.14625 shares of K-C common stock ("K-C Common Stock"), par value $1.25 per share (the "Stock Consideration"), plus (b) $3.50 in cash (the "Cash Consideration" and, together with the Stock Consideration, the "Merger Consideration").
